positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
"Development of WiMAX/LTE Protocol Stacks"

Multimedia wireless communication technology uses quality of service (QoS) to measure the rate of information transmission time, throughput (throughput), delay and Jitter and other information. Depending on the applications, QoS is required to design the scheduling and resource allocation algorithms for better performance. However, the QoS parameters are mostly based on the measurement of the effect of physical layer data transmission, and not a direct response to user experience. In the latest multimedia wireless communication, the quality of experience (QoE), a direct response to the user experience, is a new measurement method widely used in the assessment of service quality. In addition, multimedia communications, video transmission, SVC (scalable video coding) coding techniques, which have the ability to hierarchical encoding of space, time and video quality as well as its flexible and timely transfer rate control, can all be effectively incorporated to ensure the end-to-end wireless video transmission. 

We aim to take advantage of MIMO and handover techniques for better QoS, to optimize the protocol stacks of WiMAX/LTE 4G wireless standards, specifically for video uplink and downlink services.

patents.title: System and method to facilitate wireless network optimization
patents.description: An example method is provided in one example embodiment and may include determining one or more outlier access points (APs) of a plurality of APs managed by a same service provider, wherein the determining is performed based on performance metrics calculated for each of the plurality of APs and wherein each outlier AP has a performance metric that fails to satisfy a performance metric threshold; identifying a Radio Frequency (RF) cluster to which each outlier AP belongs, wherein each outlier AP belongs to only one RF cluster; applying one or more optimization parameters to one or more APs for one or more RF clusters; and calculating new performance metrics for the plurality of APs to determine whether any of the plurality of APs fail to satisfy the performance metric threshold after the one or more optimization parameters are applied.

patents.title: Method and system for lawful interception of the value-added service in ip multimedia subsystem
patents.description: A method and a system for lawfully intercepting a value-added service in an IP multimedia subsystem (IMS) are provided. In the present method, a service subscription information is sent to a first information delivery module when a suspect is registered to an IMS network. A service triggering information is sent to the first information delivery module when the value-added service subscribed by the suspect is triggered. Furthermore, when the value-added service is provided, an intercept related information (IRI) is sent to the first information delivery module according to the characteristics of the value-added service. As a result, the suspect who is using the value-added service in the IMS can be lawfully intercepted according to the information collected by the first information delivery module.
